newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 11.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivorian authorities to crack down from Monday on vehicle number plates and road worthiness tests and speed limiters on mini-buses and coaches

- Ivorian flour mill Grands Moulins d'Abidjan and bakers union agree amicable end to dispute over flour quality in presence of government minister; baker's union president publishes statement challenging the accord.

- Six companies, some with Ivorian interests, attend pre-bidding seminar on project to build new Abidjan slaughterhouse and livestock market; three are from France, one from Quebec, one from Denmark and one from South Africa.

- Student union calls 72-hour strike at Ivory Coast's Ecole Nationale Superieure (ENS), which trains nation's teachers; says authorities have ignored demands about grants, opportunities and conditions
